item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 21/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the cold front moving across the coast of Guangdong, temperatures over the region will fall appreciably this morning. Under the influence of an intense winter monsoon and upper-air disturbances, the weather over Guangdong will become cold further early to midweek this week. It will be very cold and windy with a few rain patches. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there may be thunderstorms over southern China in the latter part of this week. It will be rather cool and rainy over the coastal areas.

Date/Month: 21/01 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5.
Weather: Becoming appreciably cooler in the morning. Mainly fine and dry.
Temp range: 15 - 21 C
R.H. range: 50 - 75 per Cent
PSR: Low
